mapper.select: SELECT gb.group_buy_id, gb.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_name_jp, p.brand, p.price_jpy, p.original_price_jpy, p.thumbnail_url, gb.title, gb.description, gb.target_quantity, gb.current_quantity, gb.start_date, gb.end_date, gb.status FROM GROUP_BUY gb JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = gb.product_id WHERE gb.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY gb.group_buy_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT gb.group_buy_id, gb.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_name_jp, p.brand, p.price_jpy, p.original_price_jpy, p.thumbnail_url, gb.title, gb.description, gb.target_quantity, gb.current_quantity, gb.start_date, gb.end_date, gb.status FROM GROUP_BUY gb JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = gb.product_id WHERE gb.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY gb.group_buy_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GROUP_BUY_PARTICIPANT (group_buy_id, member_id, quantity, participation_status) VALUES (#{groupBuyId}, #{memberId}, #{quantity}, #{participationStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE GROUP_BUY_PARTICIPANT SET quantity = #{quantity}, participation_status = 'JOINED', joined_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cancelled_at = NULL WHERE participant_id = #{participantId}
UPDATE GROUP_BUY_PARTICIPANT SET quantity = quantity + #{quantity}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE participant_id = #{participantId}
UPDATE GROUP_BUY SET status = 'SUCCESS', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_buy_id = #{groupBuyId} AND current_quantity >= target_quantity
